Lists scanner groups for your Tenable Vulnerability Management instance.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.SCANNER_GROUP.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

Creates a new scanner group. You cannot use this endpoint to:
  • Assign the new scanner group to a network object. Tenable Vulnerability Management automatically assigns new scanner groups to the default network object. To assign a scanner group to a network object, use the [POST /networks/{network_id}/scanners/{scanner_uuid}](ref:networks-assign-scanner) endpoint.
  • Configure scan routes for the scanner group. Instead, use the [PUT /scanner-groups/group_id/routes](ref:io-scanner-group

params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

items.docs:
Returns details for the specified scanner group. **Note:** This endpoint does not return details about scan routes configured for the scanner group. For scan routes, use the [GET /scanner-groups/group_id/routes](ref:io-scanner-groups-list-routes) endpoint instead.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.SCANNER_GROUP.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

items.docs:
Updates a scanner group. You cannot use this endpoint to:
  • Assign a scanner group to a network object. Instead, use the [POST /networks/{network_id}/scanners/{scanner_uuid}](ref:networks-assign-scanner) endpoint.
  • Update scan routes configured for the scanner group. Instead, use the [PUT /scanner-groups/group_id/routes](ref:io-scanner-groups-update-routes) endpoint.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.SCANNER_GROUP.EDIT`

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

items.docs:
Deletes a scanner group.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.SCANNER_GROUP.DELETE` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

items.docs:
Lists scanners associated with the scanner group.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.READ`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.READ`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.READ`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

params.name: scanner_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner to add to the scanner group.

items.docs:
Adds a scanner to the scanner group. You can use the [GET /scanner-groups/{group_id}/scanners](ref:scanner-groups-list-scanners) endpoint to verify that the scanner has been added to the specified scanner group.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.EDIT`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.EDIT`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.EDIT`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group.

params.name: scanner_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner to remove from the scanner group.

items.docs:
Remove a scanner from the scanner group.
Requires the Basic [16] user role or one of the following custom role privileges: `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_SCANNER.EDIT`, `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_WAS_SCANNER.EDIT`, or `VM.VM_SENSOR.VM_NETWORK_MONITOR.EDIT`. See [Roles](doc:roles).

params.name: group_id
params.description: The ID of the scanner group. Corresponds to the `id` element in the 200 response for the [GET /scanner-groups](ref:scanner-groups-list) endpoint.

List the hostnames, wildcards, IP addresses, and IP address ranges that Tenable Vulnerability Management matches against targets in auto-routed scans. For more information about supported route formats, see [Supported Scan Routing Target Formats](doc:manage-scan-routing-tio#section-supported-scan-routing-target-formats).
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the `VM.VM_SENSOR.SCANNER_GROUP.READ` custom role privilege. See [Roles](doc:roles).
